about: YouTube channels of the 'Challenger Replays' network: one channel per LoL champion, full-game POV replays of ranked matches.
method: handle probe https://www.youtube.com/@<handle>?hl=en (200 = exists, 404 = no), metadata from ytInitialData
handle_pattern: @<ChampionId>ChallengerReplays, with exceptions listed in each entry
caveats: Video/subscriber counts are YouTube's rounded display values as of the collection date.
Channels also publish Shorts (vertical, highlight clips) - filter them out when harvesting full matches.
Only one channel (Volibear) has a verified HUD layout; the network looks template-based but every new channel still needs a visual layout check.
